class.name: DebugJoinConfig
class.brief_description: Editor authored stand in for the join arguments that auto connect a [MultiplayerTree] in debug builds.
class.description: The join intent stays coherent with the server because [member join_args] holds the very values a live client fills into the form drawn from [method NetwMultiplayer.session_get_join_schema]. Author one entry per parameter the installed handler declares after its [NetwParticipant]. [codeblock] # On a debug MultiplayerTree, assign a DebugJoinConfig and the tree hosts # straight into the game on play, skipping ConnectBrowser. debug_join.username = &"Dev" debug_join.join_args = [&"Arena", ^"Player"] [/codeblock] The array is copied on the way in and on the way out, so a tree that hosts twice off one config cannot have its second join mutated by whatever the first did with the args. [member MultiplayerTree.debug_join] is the one place it is read, and only when [method OS.has_feature] returns [code]true[/code] for [code]"debug"[/code], so a release build never auto connects.

members.member: The typed join args the tree submits alongside [member username], one per wire parameter the handler [method Netw.configure_join] installed declares. Leave it empty to express no join intent.
Display name for the auto connected player, submitted alongside [member join_args].
